title.zh: SEC crypto FAQ addresses token buybacks, network upgrades and promises of profit
title.en: SEC crypto FAQ addresses token buybacks, network upgrades and promises of profit

current_state.zh: SEC staff issued a crypto FAQ clarifying that promoting a network's current uses generally would not create an expectation of profit, while addressing how token buybacks and network upgrades bear on the securities analysis.
